We have applied first template 324324, got product(s) as precursors: a tuple of two SMILES: ('Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)O)cc2)cc1', 'Nc1ccccc1N'). That suggests the retrosynthetic step splits the amide? Actually original had ...C(=O)N c3ccccc3N (an anilide with an aniline). The template likely breaks the amide to give carboxylic acid and aniline.

Now we need to apply second template 1914396 to the first precursor (the acid). Let's apply.
